newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - Davis bids for Carter-Wallace.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - Davis bids for Carter-Wallace.

text.p: Investor Martin Davis has offered $18 per share to acquire Carter-Wallace Inc, a consumer and health care products maker.
Following is the full text of its press release. ------------------------PRESS RELEASE-------------------------

NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--October 30, 1996--Carter-Wallace, Inc. (NYSE:CAR), in response to the story that appeared in today's Wall Street Journal, confirmed that it has received a letter from Davis Companies stating that "(s)ubject to completion of our due diligence, Davis Companies is prepared to negotiate an agreement with the Company for the acquisition of all of the Company's outstanding stock at a price of $18 per share."
Carter-Wallace stated that it has referred the letter to The CPI Development Corporation, the holder of a majority of the outstanding shares of the Company.
Carter-Wallace, Inc. markets toiletries, proprietary drugs, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic specialties and pet products.
